## Answers given
- Port: tiny-shop listens on `PORT` from the environment, 3000 when it is not set (src/config.js).
- Orders: kept in memory, in a `Map` in src/store.js; they are lost when the service restarts.

## Saved to memory
- none.

## Out of reach
- I proposed `pi-memory` to remember your decision; you said Block, so it was not loaded and I will not propose it again this session. Nothing was saved.
- Unsaved note, for you to keep: `#tiny-shop #decision 2026-10-28: we keep orders in memory until we move to Postgres.`
